Procedimientos de baja visibilidad

Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

Questions and answers

What is Procedimientos de baja visibilidad?

In this glossary, Procedimientos de baja visibilidad refers to: Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

How is Procedimientos de baja visibilidad used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Torre, confirme que los procedimientos de baja visibilidad están activos e informe el estado de la barra de parada en la calle de rodaje Alfa."

Definition

Aerodrome ground-movement and approach rules activated whenever reported runway visual range falls below published minima.

Operational example

Tower, confirm low visibility procedures are in force and advise stop-bar status for Taxiway Alpha.

Localized term

Localized example
